title: The Power of a Cheerful Giver
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he shares a powerful testimony of God's faithfulness in his marriage and ministry. He'll reveal the surprising ways God spoke to him and his wife, and how their obedient response to God's voice has brought about incredible blessings and breakthroughs in their lives. Don't miss this inspiring message about the power of God's voice and the importance of seeking His kingdom first.
